scored_positions:
positions.supervised_target_v1@v1 on the hybrid's own trajectory: the positions that predict the generated tokens (prompt ids + output ids; a position i predicts token i+1), the generated <|im_end|> included; nothing of the prompt, the template or the preclosed '<think>

</think>

' of the non-thinking prompt is scored

H-T: final_answer (the positions predicting the final answer's tokens)
critical_tokens.never: a </think> the non-thinking mode never generated: its preclosed think block is prompt, not output, and is not a critical position
critical_tokens.aggregation: PROPOSED frozen rule: per mode, the unweighted mean over that mode's critical classes; state.critical_token_kl = 0.5 x H-T + 0.5 x H-N (the current evaluator averages all declared classes unweighted, which would give H-T 3/5: a small generic extension, critical classes grouped by mode, is owed before the search)

calibration._: D4's weights, kept; both profiles cover all 13 types; a domain's share is split equally over its sub-types and halved per mode

domains_and_weights.state_evaluation: its own frozen quota, independent of either profile: 12,000 scored positions per (subtype, mode), 13 x 2 x 12,000 = 312,000; ranking reduces equal sub-type (mode included) then equal domain, so a profile's raw token count confers no ranking advantage

interactive_adaptation.treatment: EXCLUDED from both data sets, consistently
why: token-level KL on a fixed episode transcript measures the student's agreement with the teacher on observations the teacher's own actions produced; it is not closed-loop interaction and must not be read as interactive ability
D4's profiles carry no interactive domain and their weights are kept (formal_design.json :: excluded_domains: too few admissible episodes, each larger than a cell quota)
interactive adaptation stays in A1/A2's training data (16.8% of fluid) and is measured closed-loop on eval-set-1's interactive units after training
interactive_adaptation.alternative_for_the_maintainer: include per-turn transcript items of the hybrid's own episodes as a sixth domain in both sets, with weights the maintainer sets: a change to D4's profile design, and still teacher-forced fidelity only

training_cells_not_typed_here.supporting.code_algorithmic/mbpp_train: MBPP is exhausted by training (every eligible task is a training task); the code type uses reasoning_core's code modules, the code cell's main training source
